cover.hook: Instagram lets you build Story effects with a prompt. Are you in?
cover.label: 5 social updates worth knowing right now

slides.headline: Build Story effects [[with a prompt]]
slides.sub: Instagram's new Effect Builder in Edits makes effects from plain text. Meta reviews each one, generally in under 24 hours.

slides.headline: TikTok's AI ad tool makes [[longer videos]]
slides.sub: Symphony Agent now uses Seedance models: up to 30 seconds per prompt, up from 15, and up to 50 references, up from 9.
slides.source: TikTok, via Social Media Today, Nov 9

slides.headline: fewer posts [[hidden]] in LinkedIn tests
slides.sub: LinkedIn says its new profile-matching feed model cut hide rate 18.8% in experiments. New members saw 17.7% more viral engagement.
slides.source: LinkedIn Engineering, via Social Media Today, Nov 9

slides.headline: jump in searches for [[face brushes]]
slides.sub: Google's 2026 Holiday 100 says lymphatic sculpting face brush searches are up 400%. Kitten heel sandals are up 295%.
slides.source: Google, via Social Media Today, Nov 9

slides.headline: users, and Edits is now on [[desktop]]
slides.sub: Meta's editing app is out for Mac with a multi-track timeline and 4K export with no watermark.
slides.source: Meta, via Social Media Today, Nov 5

take.headline: Prompt it, plan it, [[post it]]
take.sub: AI tools now build effects, ads and edits for you. Pick one this week and test it on a real post.

cta.headline: Comment [[UPDATE]] and I'll send you the full list
cta.sub: All five updates, with the sources, in one place.

stories.name: story-thu
stories.headline: Meta's Muse can build [[mini apps]]
stories.sub: Muse Spaces turns a command into a dedicated mini app inside Muse. Meta says the Muse app has passed 10 million downloads.

stories.name: story-fri
stories.headline: Would you use AI to build your [[Story effects]]?
stories.context: Instagram's new Effect Builder makes effects from a text prompt.

stories.name: story-sat
stories.headline: YouTube tests [[product picks]] for creators
stories.sub: Eligible affiliate creators see personalized product recommendations with estimated commission rates in Studio's shopping hub.
stories.source: YouTube, via Social Media Today, Nov 8

stories.name: story-sun
stories.headline: Check your [[offer settings]] in Meta ads
stories.sub: A marketing advisor found Meta's AI ads showed website discounts even when promotions were off on the original ad. Review detected offers in Commerce Manager.
stories.source: PPC Land, via Social Media Today, Nov 8

stories.name: story-mon
stories.headline: Are you planning [[holiday content]] yet?
stories.context: Google says kitten heel sandal searches are up 295% in its Holiday 100.

stories.name: story-tue
stories.headline: TikTok launches a [[Shop app]]
stories.sub: The standalone shopping app is available in Singapore, Thailand, Malaysia and the Philippines.

stories.name: story-wed
stories.headline: Test one [[AI tool]] this week
stories.sub: Effects, ads, edits. Pick one tool, try it on a real post, and note what you learn.
